common.tagline: Learn to code by doing — guided, never given

landing.heroSubtitle: Paste your exercise, code in the browser, and progress with a tutor that guides without ever giving the full solution.
landing.step1Desc: Type, paste or upload a file (PDF, image, docx). AI structures it for you.
landing.step2Desc: Lightweight editor + Python in the browser (Pyodide). Instant feedback, even offline.
landing.step3Desc: Socratic questions, progressive hints, error explanations — never the full answer.
landing.pythonOnly: Launch: Python. Architecture ready for more languages.
landing.principles: Principles: never the full solution, progressive hints, offline-first
